description:
The agent must read SKILL.md to discover the full generation workflow:
1. Parse inputs: location=挪威(Norway), days=10, trip_type=cross_region, drivers=with_kids, experience_level=beginner, car_preference=automatic, style_preference=scenic. All optional fields have valid defaults so no follow-up questioning needed.
2. Apply beginner+with_kids routing rules: daily driving ≤200km, highway/national roads only, route difficulty=LOW(低).
3. CRITICAL TRAP: trip_type=cross_region means ONLY ONE route block rendered in Card D (not two). A naive agent will render both route-1 and route-2 blocks.
4. Card A must include child seat (儿童座椅) because drivers=with_kids, plus international driving permit items due to cross-border scenario.
5. Card B must have exactly 6-10 note items using fuzzy uncertainty language ('可能需要', '可能存在') for Norwegian-specific rules.
6. Card C must have 3-5 Do items and 3-5 Don't items in proper split layout.
7. Card D cross-region route must include '建议提前了解过境手续' wording.
8. Footer must use generalized emergency number format (not a specific unverified number).
9. Subtitle labels must use the mapped Chinese terms: 新手(beginner), 跨区域(cross_region), 带娃(with_kids), 风景优先(scenic).
10. CSS must include all required color palette values from the spec (#1a365d, #38a169, #3182ce, #e53e3e, #805ad5, #dd6b20, #fefcbf).
11. No {placeholder} curly brace patterns should remain in the output HTML.
12. Mobile responsive CSS with @media max-width:600px must be present.
